text: Wrinkly bath fingers. They soaked up water and swelled, right?

speaker: fitz
text:
Not quite. If a finger's nerve is damaged, it stays smooth in the bath.
So it's your nerves. After a long soak, tiny blood vessels under the skin narrow, and the skin pulls into wrinkles.

speaker: fitz
text:
The best-known idea is grip. In one study, people moved wet marbles faster with wrinkled fingers.
But another team couldn't repeat that, so it's still debated.

speaker: gauge
